besluite.fout: 'was aan ander mense goed bekend' is a stiff, passive-like construction for a Grade 6 summary sentence
besluite.rede: The active 'Ander mense het die see dus goed geken' is what a fluent writer would write, keeps the same people, the same knowledge and the same time frame, and touches no protected wording.
At the start of the sentence 'Na Dias se reis' can only mean 'after', so the optional accent clears up no ambiguity and the change is lateral.
